name: Grendel — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Grendel from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Grendel" but are not part of the Grendel entry, which is unchanged.

Weaknesses deformed wrestler, tender ears

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 claws +34 (3d10+14/19–20 plus grab), bite +29 (4d8+7)
Ranged rock +25 (1d8+14)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks blood rage, brutal surge, gnashing teeth, gruesome dismemberment, mythic power (7/day, surge +1d10), rend (2 claws, 3d10+21), rock throwing (60 ft.)

Deformed Wrestler (Ex)

Grendel is a savage grappler on the attack and still threatens and can take attacks of opportunity when he has the grappled condition. However, his misshapen limbs reduce his CMD by 5 against grapple combat maneuvers. In addition, damage caused by a successful grapple maneuver ignores his DR.

Gnashing Teeth (Ex)

If Grendel hits a creature he has grappled with his bite attack, the target takes 2d6 points of bleed damage and 2 points of Constitution bleed each round. A creature reduced below 0 hit points by this bite attack has its throat torn out and dies immediately (DC 34 Fortitude negates) and Grendel regains 10d6 hit points if they die, or 5d6 if they survive. The save DC is Strength-based.

Gruesome Dismemberment (Ex)

A creature reduced below 0 hit points by this ability is ripped in half and instantly dies (DC 34 Fortitude negates) unless it is incorporeal or amorphous. The save DC is Strength-based.
